prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1158; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the car behind me hit the rear of my vehicle. The impact was firm enough to push me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt a sharp pain in my right knee when it struck the dashboard. I got out and spoke with the other driver, who confirmed that they had not stopped in time. I am the named driver on this policy, and I have kept the same account of what happened since that day, although I have remembered a few smaller details since then, such as the color of the traffic lights and the brief delay before the other car moved. My knee has been swollen and painful when I bend it, and I have been seeing a doctor about it.
